arxiv-1712-03792.title: Identifying the Mislabeled Training Samples of ECG Signals using Machine Learning
arxiv-1712-03792.creator: Yaoguang Li, Wei Cui £¬, Cong Wang
arxiv-1712-03792.description: Abstract The classification accuracy of electrocardiogram signal is often affected by diverse factors in which mislabeled training samples issue is one of the most influential problems. In order to mitigate this negative effect, the method of cross validation is introduced to identify the mislabeled samples.

Brammer, Pratika Dayal, Garth Illingworth, Laia Barrufet, Sirio Belli, Rachel Bezanson, Sownak Bose, Kasper E. Heintz, Joel Leja, Ecaterina Leonova,
arxiv-2208-02794.description: Abstract JWST ’s first glimpse of the z > 10 z>10 Universe has yielded a surprising abundance of luminous galaxy candidates. arxiv-2208-06633.title: Rapid multiplex ultrafast nonlinear microscopy for material characterization
arxiv-2208-06633.creator: Torben L. Purz, Blake T. Hipsley, Eric. W. Martin, Ronald Ulbricht, Steven T. Cundiff
arxiv-2208-06633.description: Abstract We demonstrate rapid imaging based on four-wave mixing (FWM) by assessing the quality of advanced materials through measurement of their nonlinear response, exciton dephasing, and exciton lifetimes. We use a WSe 2 monolayer grown by chemical vapor deposition as a canonical example to demonstrate these capabilities.

arxiv-2209-05615.title: Infinitary Logic Has No Expressive Efficiency Over Finitary Logic
arxiv-2209-05615.creator: Matthew Harrison-Trainor, Miles Kretschmer
arxiv-2209-05615.description: Abstract We can measure the complexity of a logical formula by counting the number of alternations between existential and universal quantifiers. Suppose that an elementary first-order formula φ \varphi (in ℒ ω , ω \mathcal{L}_{\omega,\omega} ) is equivalent to a formula of the infinitary language ℒ ∞ , ω \mathcal{L}_{\infty,\omega} with n n alternations of quantifiers.

arxiv-2310-15716.title: Visible Lagrangians for Hitchin systems and pillowcase covers Thanks: Research of the authors is supported by the Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft (DFG, German Research Foundation) – Project-ID 444845124 – TRR 326
arxiv-2310-15716.creator: Johannes Horn, Johannes Schwab
arxiv-2310-15716.description: Abstract . We study complex Lagrangians in Hitchin systems that factor through a proper subvariety of the Hitchin base non-trivially intersecting the regular locus. This gives a general framework for several examples in the literature. We compute the fiber-wise Fourier-Mukai transform of flat line bundles on visible Lagrangians. This proposes a construction of mirror dual branes to visible Lagrangians.

arxiv-2402-00785.title: Apparent Dark Matter Inspired by Einstein Equation of State
arxiv-2402-00785.creator: Kimet Jusufi, Ahmad Sheykhi
arxiv-2402-00785.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Kimet Jusufi, Ahmad Sheykhi. The purpose of this article is twofold. First, by means of Padmanabhan’s proposal on the emergence nature of gravity, we recover the Λ \Lambda CDM model and the effect of the dark matter in the context of cosmology.

arxiv-2409-15317.title: Shared Autonomy with IDA: Interventional Diffusion Assistance
arxiv-2409-15317.creator: Brandon J. McMahan, Zhenghao Peng, Bolei Zhou, Jonathan C. Kao
arxiv-2409-15317.description: Abstract The rapid development of artificial intelligence (AI) has unearthed the potential to assist humans in controlling advanced technologies. Shared autonomy (SA) facilitates control by combining inputs from a human pilot and an AI copilot. In prior SA studies, the copilot is constantly active in determining the action played at each time step.

arxiv-2410-13832.title: VidPanos: Generative Panoramic Videos from Casual Panning Videos
arxiv-2410-13832.creator: Jingwei Ma, Erika Lu, Roni Paiss, Shiran Zada, Aleksander Holynski, Tali Dekel, Brian Curless, Michael Rubinstein, Forrester Cole
arxiv-2410-13832.description: Abstract . Panoramic image stitching provides a unified, wide-angle view of a scene that extends beyond the camera’s field of view. Stitching frames of a panning video into a panoramic photograph is a well-understood problem for stationary scenes, but when objects are moving, a still panorama cannot capture the scene.

arxiv-2503-02109.title: Structural Transitions and Melting of 2D Ion Crystals in Traps
arxiv-2503-02109.creator: B. V. Pashinsky, A. Kato, B. Blinov
arxiv-2503-02109.description: Abstract We investigate the structural properties and melting behavior of two-dimensional ion crystals in an RF trap, focusing on the effects of ion temperature and trap potential symmetry. We identify distinct crystal structures that form under varying trapping conditions and temperatures through experimental and theoretical analyses.

arxiv-2507-21850.title: Weak solutions of a viscous model for fluid-bubbles interaction
arxiv-2507-21850.creator: Cosmin Burtea, David Gérard-Varet
arxiv-2507-21850.description: Abstract We present a system of Navier-Stokes type that describes the dynamics of several spherical bubbles of gas in a liquid. It is derived from a more complete model, where the bubbles are seen as inclusions of gas of homogeneous barotropic pressure with free surfaces.

arxiv-2602-18658.title: Communication-Efficient Personalized Adaptation via Federated-Local Model Merging
arxiv-2602-18658.creator: Yinan Zou, Md Kamran Chowdhury Shisher, Christopher G. Brinton, Vishrant Tripathi
arxiv-2602-18658.description: Abstract Parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods, such as LoRA, offer a practical way to adapt large vision and language models to client tasks. However, this becomes particularly challenging under task-level heterogeneity in federated deployments. In this regime, personalization requires balancing general knowledge with personalized knowledge , yet existing approaches largely rely on heuristic mixing rules and lack theoretical justification.

pmc-11686816.creator: JaeHyeon Seo, HoSeong Lee, YoungRak Choi, MyoungYeol Shin
pmc-11686816.description: Category:Diabetes; OtherIntroduction/Purpose:Subsequent major amputations within 1 year after initial forefoot amputations are sometimes necessary when other options for saving the foot are unavailable. Risk factors for early major amputation should be analyzed for a successful limb salvage strategy. This study aimed to analyze the risk factors for early major amputation after initial diabetic forefoot amputation.

pmc-12508908.title: Integrated multi-omics analysis reveals TMEM147 as an immunosuppressive prognostic biomarker in LUAD
pmc-12508908.creator: Lei Ding, Yi Ding
pmc-12508908.description: TMEM147, an endoplasmic reticulum (ER) membrane protein, is implicated in lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD) progression, although its precise role remains unclear. To elucidate its function, this study integrated bioinformatics analyses with experimental validation. First, TMEM147 expression was assessed using TCGA and GEO datasets, with validation performed in LUAD cell lines. Survival analysis evaluated its prognostic significance.

pmc-12816171.title: TAFRO syndrome requiring combined IL 6 and IL 1 inhibition: a case report
pmc-12816171.creator: Ahmad Wael Sultan, Eva Grießhammer, Carl Hinrichs, Lars Trenkmann, Ilske Oschlies, Leif Gunnar Hanitsch, Hildrun Haibel, Thomas Schneider, Rasmus Leistner
pmc-12816171.description: IntroductionTAFRO syndrome is a rare and severe variant of idiopathic multicentric Castleman disease (iMCD). The name-giving presentation is a combination of thrombocytopenia, anasarca, fever, reticulin fibrosis/renal dysfunction, and organomegaly. The disease’s complex but unspecific presentation shows overlapping features with hyperinflammation syndromes of infectious, malignant, or autoimmune origin.

pmc-13321722.creator: Qian Xing, Yong Cui, Xiao-Lei Gu, Xiao-Ting Li, Ying-Shi Sun

pmc-13530555.title: Poster 172. Collegiate Athletes Do Not Have Higher Musculoskeletal Health Literacy Than Their Non-Athlete Peers: A Survey of 213 College Students
pmc-13530555.creator: Samantha L Watson, Samuel B Perez, Whitney G Currie, Andrew T Pickens, Michael O Sohn, Vehniah K Tjong, Noah Forrest
pmc-13530555.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Objective:Healthcare providers perceive student-athletes to possess advanced knowledge of the musculoskeletal (MSK) system due to their years of intense athletic training and exposure to sports medicine personnel. The objective of this study is to use the Literacy in Musculoskeletal Problems (LiMP) questionnaire-a validated survey measuring MSK health literacy-to determine whether athletes, including Division I (D-I) and club athletes, possess significantly higher MSK health literacy than their non-athlete counterparts.Methods:Eligible participants were recruited from a single university with D-I athletics.

pmc-13588013.title: Vacuum–Laser Fabrication of Programmable Soft Actuators
pmc-13588013.creator: Ashkan Rezanejad, Mostafa Mousa, Yuxuan Wang, Michael Adlerstein, Junke Yao, Antonio E. Forte
pmc-13588013.description: Soft robotic actuators enable lightweight and compliant motion, but their fabrication typically relies on silicone molding, 3D printing, or textile lamination—processes that require expensive materials, long production times, or complex fabrication protocols. We introduce a rapid manufacturing strategy using low‐cost thermoplastic pouches that combines vacuum processing and laser cutting.
